title: 第一卷 第71章 人王破阵乐，我找茬都说不出这话!
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

姜无痕的话，如惊雷炸响。

在场众人，尽皆愣在原地、

晋级名额，只有三个了？

主殿内等待考校的天之骄女，至少有三十几位！

只有不足十分之一的入选概率……

一时间，所有人都疯狂了。

“梦瑶，你还愣着干嘛？赶紧上啊！”

“九龄，青儿，带着涂涂一起上……”

“姬子，你在犹豫什么？为了你兄长，你必须替姬家……拿到血脉升华的资格！”

“坏菜了，师尊照顾姜家主去了，帝子不给咱们面子……”

“至少，先争下一个名额，让咱们万欲圣宗……成为姜家姻亲再说！”

众女纷纷起身，争相论道。

无论自己的‘道’能不能入帝子法眼，先论了再说！

不然，等三个名额满了，排在后面的人，连论道的资格都没有……

一时间，众人争抢。

而引起这场争执的罪魁祸首——姜无痕，此刻却不紧不慢的陪同林清雅几人走向贵宾席，先后搀扶林清雅和沐云溪入座。

“姐夫偏心……”

安兮兮鼓着嘴角，小声嘀咕道：“兮兮明明也是姐夫的道侣，为什么……不搀扶兮兮入座？”

“你这丫头……”

姜无痕伸手捏了捏她那肉嘟嘟的小脸，淡然道：“你林姐姐和沐姐姐怀有身孕，自然要特殊照顾。”

“那……如果兮兮也怀上，姐夫是不是也会这样耐心的对待兮兮？”

安兮兮一脸希冀道。

一旁，安祈雪嗔怪道：“兮兮，大庭广众之下，不可胡言！”

这孩子，怎么能当着这么多人的面，脸不红心不跳的说出这样羞人的话……

“没关系，兮兮想说什么都可以。”

姜无痕坐在神源宝座上，抱起安兮兮，让她坐在了自己的大腿上。

随即，他看向安祈雪和柳素心，轻笑道：“你们两个也别傻站着了，入座吧！”

“夫君，让兮兮跟着我坐吧。”安祈雪轻抿粉唇，有些为难道，“她坐在夫君的腿上，这……成何体统？”

“无妨，今晨在殿内……冷落了兮兮。如今，算是本帝子对她的补偿了。”

姜无痕淡然道。

此话一出，安祈雪顿时脸色红润。

是她一夜未见姜无痕，满心思念之下，一直霸占着。

安兮兮只能坐在床边观战……

安祈雪哑口无言，跟随柳素心坐在了贵宾席上。

姜无痕的目光，重新落在了下方一众天之骄女的身上。

就在众女争执不下之际，一道恐怖的帝威，赫然降临。

只见一位娇俏可爱的少女，掌心擎着一道白光，将周围众女尽皆镇压。

姜无痕动用太古重瞳，看清了白光之下，乃是一方白玉大印，质地温润，上方盘龙。

下方有一角崩碎，用‘仙纹精金’补全。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jiang Wuhen's words were like thunder.

Everyone present was stunned on the spot.

Are there only three promotion places left?

There are at least thirty of the most beautiful girls waiting to take the entrance examination in the main hall!

There is less than one tenth chance of being selected...

For a moment, everyone went crazy.

"Meng Yao, why are you still standing there? Hurry up!"

"Jiuling, Qing'er, take Tutu with you..."

"Ji Zi, what are you hesitating about? For your brother, you must obtain the qualifications for bloodline sublimation for the Ji family..."

"It's bad food. Master has gone to take care of the Jiang family. The emperor won't give us face..."

"At least, let's fight for a spot first so that our Wan Yu Holy Sect... can become the Jiang family's in-laws!"

All the girls stood up one after another and argued among themselves.

Regardless of whether your own 'Tao' can enter the eyes of the Emperor's Dharma, let's discuss it first!

Otherwise, when the three quotas are filled, the people at the back will not even be qualified to discuss the Tao...

For a time, everyone was fighting for it.

The culprit who caused this dispute, Jiang Wuhen, was slowly accompanying Lin Qingya and others to the VIP seats, and helped Lin Qingya and Mu Yunxi to sit down.

"Brother-in-law is partial..."

An Xixi pursed her lips and murmured in a low voice: "Xixi is obviously also my brother-in-law's Taoist companion, why... don't you help Xixi sit down?"

"You girl..."

Jiang Wuhen reached out and pinched her chubby little face, and said calmly: "Your sister Lin and sister Mu are pregnant, so they naturally need special care."

"Then...if Xixi is also pregnant, will my brother-in-law treat Xixi so patiently?"

An Xixi said with hope.

On the side, An Qixue said angrily: "Hey, in public, you can't talk nonsense!"

How could this kid say such shameful words in front of so many people without blushing or heart beating...

"It doesn't matter, Xixi can say whatever she wants."

Jiang Wuhen sat on the throne of Shenyuan, picked up An Xixi, and let her sit on his lap.

Immediately, he looked at An Qixue and Liu Suxin, chuckled and said, "You two, don't just stand around like that, take a seat!"

"Husband, let Xixi sit with me." An Qixue pursed her pink lips lightly, a little embarrassed, "She is sitting on my husband's lap. How... is this inappropriate?"

"It doesn't matter, she was... indifferent in the palace this morning. Now, this is my son's compensation for her."

Jiang Wuhen said calmly.

As soon as these words came out, An Qixue's face turned rosy.

She hadn't seen Jiang Wuhen all night, so she kept occupying him with longing for him.

An Xixi could only sit by the bed and watch the battle...

An Qixue was speechless and followed Liu Suxin to sit at the VIP table.

Jiang Wuhen's eyes fell again on the proud women below.

Just when the girls were arguing, a terrifying imperial power suddenly descended.

I saw a pretty and lovely girl holding a white light in her palm, suppressing all the girls around her.

Jiang Wuhen used his ancient heavy pupils to see clearly under the white light, a large white jade seal with a warm texture and a dragon coiled above it.

A corner below was broken and was repaired with 'immortal fine gold'.
